The Golden Dome catalyst from the prior report already happened — RDW was selected into the $151B SHIELD IDIQ pool on Jan 27, 2026 (stock +29% that day) — so the thesis now hinges on actual task-order wins, not pool selection. Stock is ~62% below its 52-week high ($26.64) after a $500M ATM equity program (June 2026) diluted the post-selection re-rate. ค่าขนม sizing 3-4% max, smaller than before given the dilution overhang.
sector: Space & Defense Technology — Space Infrastructure + UAS/Drones
summary: Redwire's original Golden Dome catalyst already resolved: it won a spot in the $151B SHIELD IDIQ missile-defense pool on Jan 27, 2026 (+29% that day), but an IDIQ ceiling guarantees no revenue — RDW must now win specific task orders against L3Harris, Anduril, Palantir and Lockheed. A second growth engine has emerged since the last report: Edge Autonomy's Stalker UAS drones are landing repeat military follow-on orders ($20M Q1, $21.5M Q2) and just made the DoD's Blue List. Q2 2026 earnings land tomorrow (Aug 5, after close) as the nearest binary catalyst, testing whether $450-500M FY26 revenue guidance holds. Dilution is the real overhang: a $500M ATM program (June 2026) stacked on a $350M ATM and $249.7M already sold under a prior program has helped drag the stock ~62% off its 52-week high even though the core Golden Dome win still stands — liquidity itself (~$175M, burn slowing to -$12.7M/quarter) is not a near-term survival concern.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Redwire reports Q2 2026 results after market close on Aug 5, 2026 (call Aug 6, 9am ET). This is the first real test of whether the Golden Dome selection, the $1.8B Andromeda IDIQ, first ELSA order, and Stalker UAS follow-on orders are converting into revenue against the $450-500M FY2026 guide reaffirmed last quarter.

catalysts.name: Golden Dome SHIELD IDIQ — Task Order Awards
catalysts.description: RDW already won a seat in the $151B multi-vendor SHIELD IDIQ pool for missile-defense/homeland-defense work (Jan 27, 2026, alongside Palantir, Anduril, Lockheed, AeroVironment, Blue Origin). Pool membership guarantees nothing — the next re-rate needs an actual task order. H.C. Wainwright still flags initial large-scale Golden Dome task awards as a 2026 catalyst.

catalysts.name: Stalker UAS Recurring Military Orders
catalysts.description: Edge Autonomy's Stalker drone just earned an Authority to Operate and a spot on the DoD's Blue UAS List. Repeat follow-on purchase orders ($20M Q1, $21.5M Q2 2026) from the U.S. military's Family of Small UAS program show recurring demand, backed by a 164,000 sq ft Huntsville, AL capacity expansion ($8.5M in incentives) targeting higher production by Q4 2027.

risks: Still deeply unprofitable — Q1 2026 net loss $76.5M (though >$44M was non-recurring Edge Autonomy stock comp) and FCF still negative (-$12.7M in Q1, improving from -$49M a year ago but not yet cash-flow positive

Active $500M ATM equity program (June 2026), on top of a $350M ATM and $249.7M already sold under a prior Nov 2025 program — real, ongoing dilution risk even though liquidity (~$175M cash + undrawn revolver) is not a near-term survival issue at the current burn rate

Golden Dome SHIELD IDIQ is a multi-vendor ceiling contract with zero guaranteed revenue — RDW still has to out-compete L3Harris, Anduril, Palantir and Lockheed for specific task orders; the initial pool-selection pop has already happened and partly reversed

Extreme volatility (beta 3.02) — stock has round-tripped from a 52-week low of $4.87 to a high of $26.64 and back to under $10; a Q2 earnings miss on Aug 5 could trigger a sharp single-day drawdown given how much good news is already priced in

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.50-3.75% on Jul 29, 2026 with 3 hawkish dissents favoring a hike — rate-hike tail risk into year-end hasn't gone away. RDW's revenue is tied to appropriated DoD/NASA/ESA contracts, not rate-sensitive financing, so this matters less fundamentally than for most stocks.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core PCE still 3.3% YoY, well above the 2% target — but RDW's IDIQ and program contracts carry multi-year fixed ceilings with limited near-term inflation pass-through risk to the thesis.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: LOW direct impact, but beta of 3.02 means a hawkish macro tape (equity de-risking, high-beta small caps sold first) can still hit RDW hard even when the underlying government-contract thesis is intact — as seen in its round trip from $26.64 to under $10.
macroRisk.summary: Macro risk is secondary here — RDW's own catalyst calendar (Q2 earnings Aug 5, Golden Dome task orders) and its dilution overhang dominate the stock's direction far more than Fed policy does, though its high beta amplifies broader risk-off moves.

entryStrategy.verdict: Moonshot SPECULATIVE — 2-3% sizing (down from 3-5%). Golden Dome pool seat is already won; the trade now is Q2 earnings (Aug 5) plus task-order conversion, against a real dilution overhang. Small starter now, add only on confirmed contract or earnings strength.

catalystSpot.preRunup: RDW itself just showed the pattern: it ran +10.9-11.8% on Aug 3, 2026 — two days before Q2 earnings — purely on Stalker UAS follow-on order and facility-expansion headlines. Contract-flow news in the run-up to earnings reliably moves this stock double digits before the print itself lands.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 1-2 days before earnings, on contract-flow headlines

postWin.note: RDW's own history: +29% same-day on the Jan 27, 2026 SHIELD IDIQ pool selection (CNBC/TipRanks), and +11.8% on Aug 3, 2026 pre-earnings on Stalker UAS follow-on military orders. This exact stock reliably pops double digits on contract-flow wins.

postLose.note: RDW's own round trip is the cautionary case: after the +29% Golden Dome pop on Jan 27, 2026, shares gave back the gain and more as a $350M-then-$500M ATM equity program (announced June 2026) diluted the re-rate — RDW now trades ~62% below its 52-week high of $26.64 even though the Golden Dome win itself was never reversed. Dilution overhang can erase a catalyst win's gains with no bad news required.

Sizing stays speculative-only given the $500M ATM overhang; scale in only on confirmed Q2 strength or a real task-order win, not on pool-membership headlines alone.
